_README: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR THE CLIENT ROSTER.
Edit this file, then run `python tools/build-roster.py`. It writes the cards
into site/work/index.html between the two ROSTER markers, and writes
site/assets/js/clients.js for the overlay. Adding a client is one record
here and one command - never hand-edited markup in two places that can
disagree about how many clients there are.
THE HOUSE RULE APPLIES TO EVERY FIELD. null means 'we have not been told',
and renders as a visible [[NEEDS: ...]] on the page. It does NOT mean
'write something plausible'. Every non-null string below is traceable to
reference/reference-sites.md, to brief/04-asset-inventory.md, to the
client's own published site, or to a case page in site/work/.
FIELDS
slug      file-safe id. Must match the _manifest.json key when mark=true.
name      as the client writes it.
sector    the client's own words where they publish them. null if unknown.
cat       the filter shelf. One of the keys in _categories. null = shows
only under Everything, and the roster says so in a note.
band      case | live | mark. Depth of what is on file, not job size.
href      a case page in site/work/, relative. Routes instead of opening
the overlay.
site      the client's live site. null where there is nothing to link.
mark      true when tools/build-client-marks.py has built files for this
slug. false means set initials instead - our setting, which is
honest, where a logo we do not have would not be.
init      the initials to set when mark is false.
line      the one line on the card. null leaves the card short rather
than filling it.
note      an honest caveat shown in place of a link or a figure.
came      what the client came with. The problem, one line.
did       what we did. The approach, one line.
got       what they got. A list of deliverables.
outcome   what happened. [value, label] - or null, or the string
"unpublished", which renders as the qual-note sentence rather
than as a placeholder, because 'the client has not published a
number' is a real answer and a different one from 'nobody asked'.

_category_notes.interiors: Aware Acoustics is shelved under Interiors. Acoustics is a built-environment trade; the word the client publishes is 'Acoustics' and that is what the card says.
_category_notes.studio: Nuozone Studio is shelved under Studios from the client's own name. No sector for it is on file.
_category_notes.null: Tulipss carries no published sector, so it appears only under Everything rather than being filed under a guess.
